chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Sama'ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithamī from Aban ibn Uthman from Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Abū al-ʿAbbās, who both said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) said: 'It is not for the man to have sexual intercourse with his wife on the night of Wednesday.'

key_terms.يَدْخُلُ: To have sexual intercourse (specifically entering the wife)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marital intimacy on the night of Wednesday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the makrūh (disliked) nature of marital relations on the night of Wednesday, reflecting the broader Shia tradition of assigning spiritual significance to specific days of the week. Scholars often contextualize this within the framework of *tawassul* and *istikhara*, where certain nights are considered more auspicious for seeking divine guidance or avoiding specific actions to align with cosmic rhythms.
